stressRelief.description: Stress fade: Stress points that fade every minute. Shooting and fast driving add stress.

stressSpeed.description: Stress speed: Driving faster than this may add a stress point. 0 turns it off.

stressSpeedChance.description: Speed stress chance: Chance per speed change above the stress speed to add a point.

stressShot.description: Stress per shot: Points a shot adds, at most once a second. 0 turns it off.

keyHints.description: Key hints: The keys of what the player can do now (on foot, in a vehicle) on the left of the screen. Which keys show, and when, is set per key in the Server panel's Keybinds tab.

minimap.description: Minimap: Always, or only while in a vehicle. Players can still turn it on for themselves in /hud.

minimapZoom.description: Minimap zoom in vehicles: How far the minimap zooms in while in a vehicle (higher shows less around you, 1100 is close). 0 keeps the game's own zoom.

custom.description: Own waypoint colour: Paint the map waypoint and its route in the colour below. Off gives the game's purple back.

voice.description: Voice: Microphone and voice range (needs pma-voice).

identity.description: Name and job: Top right: the job, its grade, the server id and the character name.
